networks.name: plainly_document_helper
networks.description: Paste a bank letter, lab report, rental agreement or bill, and get it explained in plain words. Your personal details are hidden before any agent reads it.
sample_queries: Load the bank sample and tell me what I need to do and by when.
Pin a checklist of what I need to do.
Where can I complain if my bank freezes my account?
Is a deposit of two months' rent normal?
Can you send this letter to my bank for me?

on_device.note: When the visitor's Chrome has Gemini Nano, the page answers OpenAI-compatible requests to this router in the browser itself (js/nano-router.js). No key, no server, nothing leaves the device. Other visitors use the default router with their own key.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
